goal: task 分解済み flow で implement / review / gate-impl が current task の範囲で実行されることを CLI が強制する。currentTaskId がない broad 実行は既定で失敗し、明示 opt-in された broad mode だけを監査記録つきで許可する。

in: must: task 分解済み flow における implement / review / gate-impl の currentTaskId 必須化。
must: current task の requirements / files / task spec へ gate-impl 入力を限定すること。
must: task 完了後に次 task へ進む手順を CLI 出力で明示すること。
must: bulk 実装が必要な場合の明示 broad mode と監査記録。
should: final report への task 単位の実装・検証結果の反映。
must: 上記を検証するテスト追加または既存テスト更新。
out: task 分解アルゴリズム自体の再設計。
Issue #321 の実装内容の再修正。
docs 生成パイプラインや preset system の挙動変更。
npm publish / dist-tag など release 操作。

constraints: Node.js 組み込みモジュールのみを使い、外部依存は追加しない。
alpha 版ポリシーに従い、旧 flow 形式や非推奨 broad fallback の後方互換コードは追加しない。
backward-compatible-cli-interface: currentTaskId がない broad 実行を既定失敗へ変更するため、CLI error output は recovery command と explicit broad mode command を表示する migration plan を含める。
exit-code-contract: task 分解済み flow で currentTaskId が null のまま implement / review / gate-impl を実行しようとした場合、明示 broad mode がない限り command は ok:false envelope と非ゼロ終了で失敗する。
validate-user-input-at-entry-point: broad mode を有効化する user-facing argument は reason の非空文字列を必須にし、未知 task id や空 reason を entry point で拒否する。
src/templates/ または src/presets のテンプレートを変更した場合は sdd-forge upgrade を実行する。

spec-test-coverage acknowledged exception: spec-local requirement tests remain under specs/258-task-scoped-impl-flow/tests/ with requirement coverage, while tests/e2e/flow/gate-impl-integration.test.js is updated only as a project regression fixture because the new currentTaskId invariant invalidates its old task-impl setup.

no-overengineering acknowledged exception: shared task-scope, broad-mode, report-row, and task-review helpers are intentionally named because the same cursor, audit, bounded-reporting, and task-spec input rules are used across dispatcher, review, gate, status, report, and tests; inlining them would duplicate policy checks and make R1-R6 enforcement inconsistent.
design_principles: task cursor は flow state の正規 source of truth とし、AI や operator の記憶に依存しない。
task-level gate と integration gate は同じ gate-impl 名を共有しても、入力 scope と phase を明確に分ける。
broad mode は例外経路として扱い、理由・時刻・対象 step を audit trail に残す。
task 完了後の次アクションは CLI output に表示し、ユーザーが次 task の開始手順を推測しないで済むようにする。

modules.text: `src/flow/lib/get-next-action.js` resolves the next flow or task action. It must prefer pending task promotion over flow-level implementation steps when tasks remain.
`src/flow/lib/run-review.js` and `src/flow/lib/run-gate.js` execute review and gate commands. They must reject unintended broad execution for task-decomposed flows.
`src/lib/flow-store.js` and `src/lib/flow-helpers.js` own tasks[], currentTaskId, notes, metrics, and task promotion state.
`src/flow/lib/run-finalize-cleanup.js` builds the final report. It must surface task-level implementation and verification results when tasks exist.

data_flow.text: After approval syncs spec tasks into flow.json, the dispatcher promotes a pending task only when no task is already in_progress and no task step is in_progress.
Review and gate commands load flow state, derive task scope from currentTaskId, and use the current task spec markdown as the task-scoped input source.
Explicit broad mode writes an audit entry to flow state before broad implement/review/gate can run; final reporting reads that audit trail with task metrics.

decisions.text: [VERIFY] Existing flow state already has tasks[] and currentTaskId, so this spec strengthens enforcement instead of introducing a parallel cursor.
decisions.evidence: src/lib/flow-store.js rejects missing tasks/currentTaskId fields and resolves metrics/notes by currentTaskId. src/lib/flow-helpers.js exposes promoteNextPending(state).

decisions.text: [VERIFY] Task gate and integration gate are already separable phases; the fix should preserve that phase boundary.
decisions.evidence: src/flow/definition.js defines task-level gate-impl and flow-level gate-impl. src/flow/lib/gate-step.js resolves task gate-impl to task-impl and flow gate-impl to integration.

decisions.text: Default behavior is strict task scope. Broad mode remains available only through explicit opt-in with a non-empty reason.
decisions.evidence: Issue #325 asks to prohibit broad gate with currentTaskId null or require explicit opt-in, and requires bulk implementation to be recorded as explicit broad mode.
decisions.consideredAlternatives: Complete broad mode removal was rejected because the Issue explicitly preserves bulk implementation as an auditable exception.

decisions.text: Mid-implementation null cursor is not auto-recovered. Auto-promotion is allowed only at dispatcher cursor boundaries before task work starts or after task completion.
decisions.evidence: Issue #325 requires implement/review/gate-impl without currentTaskId to fail in task-decomposed flow. AGENTS.md alpha policy rejects compatibility shims for old paths.

decisions.text: Task-scoped gate/review inputs use the rendered current task spec as the source. Parent requirement filtering and file-map filtering are not used for task gates.
decisions.evidence: spec-review.json finding notes task schema has goal, acceptance, implementation_notes, and test_strategy. Therefore the task spec markdown is the concrete task-scoped source.

decisions.text: Impact list: task-decomposed implementation rejects unintended broad execution, task review/gate inputs shrink to task spec scope, final reports include task rows, and tests cover new cursor failures.
decisions.evidence: Derived from scope.in, R1-R6, acceptance criteria, and Issue #325 Expected Improvements.

background: Issue #325 reports that Issue #321 decomposed work into T-1 through T-7, but implementation continued with currentTaskId null. Review and gate-impl then evaluated the whole diff and all requirements, causing excessive input and long-running loops. The codebase already stores tasks[] and currentTaskId and has task-level definitions, but flow-level implementation actions can still run when task work remains. This spec turns task cursor usage into a CLI-enforced invariant.

requirements.desc: When currentTaskId is null, no task has status in_progress, no task step is in_progress, and a pending leaf task exists, the dispatcher must promote that leaf before returning implementation actions.

When task work remains but the safe promotion predicate is false and currentTaskId is null, flow-level implement, review, and gate-impl must fail unless explicit broad mode is active for the attempted step.

Task-level review and gate-impl must use currentTaskId to load the rendered current task spec markdown as the task-scoped input source, and must not use parent requirement IDs or file-map filtering for task gates.

Explicit broad mode must require a non-empty reason before get-next-action can return broad implement or before review/gate can run broad, record the step, reason, timestamp, and task cursor state in flow state, and be visible in status or report output.
After a task gate passes and task completion side effects run, CLI output must show the completed task id and the next task start or completion state.

Final report output should include one row or section per task with task id, task status, implementation summary availability, test-execute result, review result, and gate-impl result when those artifacts exist.

acceptance_criteria: Given a flow with tasks[] containing a pending leaf task, currentTaskId null, no in_progress task, and no in_progress task step, `sdd-forge flow get next-action` returns a task-scoped action and sets currentTaskId to that task.

Given a flow with an in_progress task or in_progress task step but currentTaskId null, `sdd-forge flow get next-action` fails with recovery guidance unless explicit broad mode for implement is active.
Given a task-decomposed implementation flow with currentTaskId null and no explicit broad mode, `sdd-forge flow run review` fails before spawning the review agent.

Given a task-decomposed implementation flow with currentTaskId null and no explicit broad mode, `sdd-forge flow run gate --phase integration` or auto-resolved gate-impl fails before building a broad prompt.
Given explicit broad mode with a non-empty reason, the broad implement, review, or gate path records the reason and attempted step in flow state.
Given currentTaskId is set, task review/gate prompt input includes the rendered task spec markdown and excludes parent requirement ID filtering and file-map filtering.
Given a task gate PASS, the command output shows the completed task id and either the next currentTaskId or that no pending tasks remain.
Given finalized task-decomposed flow artifacts, the final report includes task-level implementation and verification results.

clarifications.q: Should broad mode be completely removed?
clarifications.a: No. Broad mode is allowed only as an explicit exception with a non-empty reason and audit record, because Issue #325 includes bulk implementation as a required exceptional path.

clarifications.q: How should existing midway flows with tasks[] and currentTaskId null behave?
clarifications.a: Implementation commands fail unless currentTaskId is null, no task has status in_progress, no task step is in_progress, and a pending leaf task can be promoted before work starts.

clarifications.q: What source defines task-scoped review and gate inputs?
clarifications.a: The rendered current task spec markdown is the task-scoped source. Task gates do not filter parent requirement IDs or file-map entries because the existing task schema does not provide structured requirement IDs or file sets.

clarifications.q: How can broad implementation be opted into?
clarifications.a: A broad mode audit record must be created before get-next-action may return a broad implement action. The record includes step=implement, a non-empty reason, timestamp, and the null cursor state.

clarifications.q: What exit code contract applies to new failures?
clarifications.a: User-triggered task scope violations return ok:false flow envelopes and non-zero process exit through the existing flow command error path.

alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because Issue #325 requires bulk implementation to be possible when it is recorded as explicit broad mode.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep current broad fallback and rely on skill instructions.
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected because the reported bug is that AI or operator memory can bypass task order; CLI state must enforce the cursor.

alternatives_considered.option: Auto-recover any null currentTaskId by choosing the next pending task.
alternatives_considered.reason: Rejected for mid-implementation commands because the correct task cannot be inferred after manual edits or review changes have occurred.

tasks.title: Enforce task cursor
tasks.goal: Promote pending tasks before flow-level implementation actions and reject null currentTaskId when task work remains.
acceptance: get-next-action promotes the next pending task before flow-level implement/review/gate-impl when task work remains.
Implementation-phase commands fail with ok:false when task work remains and currentTaskId is null without explicit broad mode.
Failure output includes recovery guidance for starting or restoring a task cursor.
tasks.implementation_notes: Focus on dispatcher and command preflight boundaries in get-next-action, run-review, and run-gate. Reuse existing promoteNextPending and flow envelope patterns. Add a small class if a reusable task-scope decision object is needed.
tasks.test_strategy: Unit tests for get-next-action promotion and command preflight rejection with synthetic flow states.

tasks.title: Record broad mode
tasks.goal: Add explicit broad mode opt-in with non-empty reason and an audit record that downstream commands can verify.
acceptance: Broad mode cannot be enabled with an empty reason.
Broad mode records step, reason, timestamp, and currentTaskId at the time of opt-in.
get-next-action returns broad implement only when the audit record matches step=implement.
Review or gate broad execution succeeds only when the audit record matches the attempted broad step.
tasks.implementation_notes: Expose the smallest CLI surface that fits existing flow set/run command patterns. Validate user-facing args at the entry point. Store audit data in flow state using the existing append-only state style. The implement entrypoint is get-next-action: it may return flow-level run-impl only when broad mode has an audit record for step=implement.
tasks.test_strategy: Command tests for valid and invalid broad mode opt-in plus command preflight behavior with and without the record.

tasks.title: Scope task gates
tasks.goal: Ensure task-level review and gate prompts use current task requirements, task spec, and task metrics instead of flow-wide requirements.
acceptance: Task gate prompt input references the rendered current task spec markdown.
Task gate prompt input does not use parent requirement ID filtering or file-map filtering.
Task review and gate retry metrics remain task-scoped when currentTaskId is set.
Integration gate remains flow-scoped only after no pending tasks remain or explicit broad mode is active.
tasks.implementation_notes: Work in prompt/context assembly paths and gate phase resolution. Preserve existing task-impl versus integration phase separation.
tasks.test_strategy: Prompt/context unit tests or snapshot-style assertions that currentTaskId changes the included requirement/task content.

tasks.title: Report task results
tasks.goal: Show task completion and verification results in task completion output and the final report.
acceptance: Task gate PASS output includes completed task id and next task id or no-pending-task state.
Final report includes task id, task status, implementation summary availability, test-execute result, review result, and gate-impl result when present.
Explicit broad mode records appear in status or final report output.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use existing task state, metrics, notes, issue-log, and finalize report assembly. Do not invent report data when artifacts are missing; display missing values explicitly.
tasks.test_strategy: Unit tests for report rendering with multiple tasks, missing artifacts, and broad mode audit entries.

tasks.title: Cover task flow
tasks.goal: Add regression tests for task cursor enforcement, broad mode audit behavior, task-scoped gate inputs, and task result reporting.
acceptance: Tests cover currentTaskId null failure for review and gate in task-decomposed flow.
Tests cover next-action task promotion after tasks are synced.
Tests cover explicit broad mode audit and final report task output.
tasks.implementation_notes: Prefer existing tests/flow patterns and spec-local tests under specs/258-task-scoped-impl-flow/tests with spec requirement headers.
tasks.test_strategy: Run targeted tests first, then npm test. Run npm run test:agent only if agent invocation boundaries or AI prompts are changed.
